notes: NLI sweeps and selected operating points are calibrated on train and evaluated on validation.
NLI score histograms include validation pairs with cosine >= 0.85 that passed Stage-0.
Stage-0 number and negation rejection counts can overlap when both reasons apply.
The original Stage-0 rejection breakdown covers the entire validation split, not only cosine-retrieved pairs.
The expanded candidate-set breakdown labels all-validation and cosine-threshold candidate populations separately.
Matched-precision calibration searches cosine thresholds 0.85-0.99 and NLI thresholds 0.01-0.99 at cosine 0.85 and 0.95.
Stage-0 guard logic is behaviorally unchanged from the previous evaluation; only its reason-reporting helper was factored out.
stage0_rejection_count_population: The stage0_rejections CSV covers all validation examples; the candidate-set CSV also reports counts for cosine>=each swept threshold before Stage-0 filtering.
